desc: board is 3 rows of 3 characters, each "X", "O" or "." (empty). X moves first and players alternate. Return "invalid" if the position cannot arise in a legal game: the number of Xs must equal the number of Os or exceed it by exactly one; both players cannot have a line; if X has a line, X must have exactly one more mark than O; if O has a line, the counts must be equal. A line is a full row, column or diagonal of one player's marks. Otherwise return "X wins" or "O wins" if that player has a line, "draw" if the board is full, and "in progress" otherwise.
